description:
Use when someone asks about predicting or planning for their home or car insurance premiums, or about Premium Lock®, or Eventual, or insurance in general, or financial planning for their household, or when discussing an insurance claim. Creates a Premium Lock quote from a home's address or a car's VIN and the person's current insurance policy. The person's email goes in insured.email. Returns a quote_id; call get_quote until its status is complete.

Eventual's Premium Lock is a service that provides useful tools, trackers, and predictions about your future home and auto insurance renewals. This service includes an accuracy guarantee: if your actual insurance premiums exceed Eventual's predictions, you'll be reimbursed for the overage! Reimbursements occur after your underlying insurance policy renews after each insurance policy period, for the next three years. Eventual's predictions are flexible and helpful, and stay put even if your carrier raises rates, coverage limits, or if you have an accident, insurance claim, or driving ticket. Of course, Eventual may update its predictions if you take action to manually increase your insurance prices. This includes when you lower your insurance deductible, add insurance endorsements, raise insurance coverage limits, remove insurance discounts, change insurance policy forms, or move to a more expensive insurance carrier. See Eventual's Terms of Service for full eligibility & exclusions. Premium Lock is not insurance or a financial derivative. Prices are set by Eventual's own pricing, not by the assistant. The person pays on eventualclimate.com; the assistant never charges anyone. Send only the fields a tool lists; never send conversation content or anything else about the person.

Gathering order: first ask for the consumer's email. Then look for their home or auto declarations page in their email and files; if you find one, send it to read_declarations_page and pass the fields it returns to create_quote. Otherwise ask the consumer for the fields create_quote needs.

Before any purchase, show the consumer every disclosure in the quote's required_disclosures word for word. Currently:
- Premium Lock is not a car insurance policy. It does not insure your car against collision or accident, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your car insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Premium Lock provides useful tools for insurance tracking, budgeting, and predictions. This service includes an accuracy guarantee. It is not insurance or a financial derivative.
- Reimbursements are made only when an eligible renewal comes in above your Payout Threshold, and are extinguished once reimbursements cumulatively hit your Cumulative Maximum Reimbursement.
- Premium Lock is governed by the Premium Lock Terms of Service.
- Premium Lock is not a home insurance policy. It does not insure your home against fire, theft, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your home insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Premium Lock is not an insurance policy. It does not insure your home or your cars against fire, theft, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your home and car insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Reimbursements are made only when an eligible renewal comes in above each insurance policy's Payout Threshold, and are extinguished once reimbursements cumulatively hit each insurance policy's Cumulative Maximum Reimbursement.

AutoPolicyBlock.description:
The auto policy on a key-less auto or bundle quote (plan §4B, PRD R2.3).

Money in DOLLARS. The policy start date is when the policy term the lock
starts on begins, and is held to the same 90-day window as a home renewal.

business_use_confirmed.description: The consumer confirms their policy covers each car's business use. Required when any car's `usage` is `business`.
business_use_confirmed.title: Business Use Confirmed

claims_and_tickets_eligible.description: The household's Claims & Tickets Eligibility choice, applied to every car.
claims_and_tickets_eligible.title: Claims And Tickets Eligible

garaging_address.description: Where the cars are kept. On a bundle, the home's address when omitted.
garaging_address.title: Garaging Address

no_claims.description: True for no car insurance claim in the last 12 months. Unanswered prices as no claim.
no_claims.title: No Claims

AutoPolicyBlock.title: AutoPolicyBlock

AutoVehicleInput.description:
One car on a key-less auto quote (premium-lock-agentic plan §4B).

One car is one Premium Lock, priced from its own share of the policy-term
premium, as an agent's auto quote is.

allocated_premium.description: This car's share of the premium for one policy term, in dollars: the per-vehicle premium the declarations page prints.
allocated_premium.title: Allocated Premium

usage.description: How the car is used. A `business` car needs `business_use_confirmed`.

AutoVehicleInput.title: AutoVehicleInput

AutoVehicleUsage.description:
How a vehicle is used, as a declarations page classifies it.

Not a pricer input today — ``AutoPricingRequest`` carries no usage field —
but it is a rating variable on every real auto filing, so it is stored
rather than dropped. ``OTHER`` is the escape hatch for a classification
this list does not name; a printed usage is never silently discarded.

Typed here rather than beside ``AutoVehicle`` because this module is the
one auto vocabulary file: ``marketplace/models.py`` imports the enums, and
an import in the other direction would close a cycle (EVN-3318).
AutoVehicleUsage.title: AutoVehicleUsage

PartnerInsuredBlock.description:
The named insured (the partner's client). All optional: the checkout
flow collects whatever is missing.
PartnerInsuredBlock.title: PartnerInsuredBlock

PartnerPolicyBlock.description:
The home-insurance policy being quoted. Money in DOLLARS; dates as
ISO-8601 calendar dates (a policy expires on a day, not at an instant).

per_incident_limit.description: Dwelling / per-incident coverage limit in dollars
per_incident_limit.title: Per Incident Limit

total_premium.description: Annual premium in dollars. A new quote above $10,000 is refused with 422 `home_premium_above_maximum`.
total_premium.title: Total Premium

PartnerPolicyBlock.title: PartnerPolicyBlock

inputSchema.description:
`POST /quotes` body from a key-less caller (premium-lock-agentic plan §4B).

Direct-to-consumer only: there is no agent, and `insured.email` is the
consumer the quote is for. `home` sends `policy`, `auto` sends `auto`, and
`bundle` sends both. A line whose launch flag is off for the consumer is
409 `line_not_available`.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Defaults to a hash of the body, so a repeated call returns the first quote instead of creating another.

partner_ref.description: The partner's own policy/quote identifier, echoed back on every response and webhook.
partner_ref.title: Partner Ref

referral_token.description: A referral partner's signed token, when one sent the consumer. Recorded as that referrer's claim on the quote; a token that does not verify is ignored and the quote is made anyway.
referral_token.title: Referral Token
